# Victor Boixeda

> Personal portfolio of Victor Boixeda, a communication and marketing student (Bachelor's, ISEG Bordeaux, since 2025) based in Bordeaux, France. Community manager and competition caster for Sea of Thieves France (largest affiliated community of the game, 100,000+ members). Go-to-market internship at La Fréquence du Vivant, a biodiversity project (January–August 2026). Looking for a marketing internship of up to four months. The site exists in French (reference) and English.

Key facts:

- Languages: French (native), English (C1), Spanish (B2).
- Sea of Thieves France (since January 2025, volunteer, remote): referee, events team, official stream host, community manager since May 2026, sole caster for competitive events. TikTok and YouTube: about 1,200 followers from zero, 222k views and 15.7k likes in four months. Zevent charity marathon: €4,324 raised, 44 hours live, four days on site.
- La Fréquence du Vivant (public relations officer, intern): wrote seven sales brochures, the partner kit and the ambassador guide; called 50 vineyards and 100+ prospects; one château signed, a second in advanced negotiation; co-designed the Territoire Vivant mediation game with the team.
- Other experience: Hourglass Outpost (competitive Sea of Thieves project launched solo in 2025, showmatch on Twitch), a school brand workshop (team lead, 1st regionally, 2nd nationally), student recruitment sales at ISEG Bordeaux (November 2025 – February 2026).
- Education: French baccalauréat with highest honours (mathematics, physics and chemistry), Spanish Bachillerato, Lycée Max Linder (2025).
